WITH shelved_metadata AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST), top_memory_range_display_names AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key, tmr.display_name AS top10_display_name, tmr.memory_mb_range, tmr.memory_mb_variance, tmr.memory_mb_stddev, tmr.has_active_info_cache FROM shelved_metadata AS sm JOIN top_memory_range_display_names AS tmr ON sm.display_name = tmr.display_name ORDER BY tmr.memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST, sm.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, sm.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = (SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID), (SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE) AS per_state) AS avg_state_counts), display_name_memory_stddev AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.NETWORK_INFO, f.window_column, f.total_forge_instances_in_state, f.avg_forge_instances_per_state, dms.memory_mb_stddev, dms.deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM forge_instances AS f JOIN display_name_memory_stddev AS dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.UUID NULLS FIRST
WITH MemoryByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.total_memory_mb, am.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > am.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < am.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am), StddevOutliersByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedDisplayNames AS (SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'High Total Memory vs Benchmark' AS reason FROM MemoryByDisplayName UNION ALL SELECT display_name, NULL AS total_memory_mb, NULL AS benchmark, NULL AS memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, 'High Memory Stddev vs Average' AS reason FROM StddevOutliersByDisplayName) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, reason FROM CombinedDisplayNames ORDER BY display_name NULLS FIRST, reason NULLS FIRST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, ie.flavor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.hostname NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT ic.uuid, ic.hostname, ic.flavor, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, (CAST(i.memory_mb * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0), 0)) AS memory_per_vcpu_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.uuid = ic.uuid WHERE (CAST(i.memory_mb * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0), 0)) > 2048), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY ie.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE (CAST(inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((SELECT MAX(inner_cte2.memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2), 0)) > 0.75) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Meeting_MemoryPerVcpu_Threshold, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Above_75pct_Max_Memory, ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS Ratio_MemoryPerVcpuQualified_To_Above75pctMaxMemory FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS (SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.USER_ID, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.POWER_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ZoneAverages AS za ON za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS AS m2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY q1.availability_zone NULLS FIRST, q1.project_id NULLS FIRST, q1.instance_id NULLS FIRST
WITH memory_stats_by_display_name AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (CAST(AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(MAX(i.MEMORY_MB), 0)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST), forge_metadata_windowed AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.window_column, stats.total_rows, stats.avg_window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) AS stats ON 1 = 1) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_stats_by_display_name) AS qualifying_display_name_count, (SELECT total_rows FROM forge_metadata_windowed LIMIT 1) AS forge_total_rows, (SELECT avg_window_column FROM forge_metadata_windowed LIMIT 1) AS forge_avg_running_sum_id
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, q2.min_instance_id, q2.avg_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.VM_STATE NULLS FIRST, q1.DISPLAY_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH CompletedMigrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0), InstanceMemory AS (SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory AS im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am ORDER BY im.migration_id NULLS FIRST), Flare3HighMemInstances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb NULLS FIRST) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_display_name, cm.rank_within_status, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb, f.uuid AS flare3_instance_uuid, f.vm_state AS flare3_vm_state, f.memory_mb AS flare3_memory_mb, f.network_info AS flare3_network_info, f.window_column AS flare3_windowed_avg_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN Flare3HighMemInstances AS f ON f.display_name = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id NULLS FIRST, f.memory_mb NULLS FIRST
WITH vm_state_migration_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC NULLS LAST), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC NULLS LAST), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.migration_id NULLS FIRST) SELECT cem.migration_id, cem.instance_uuid, cem.migration_status, cem.source_compute, cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total AS vm_state_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.benchmark AS vm_state_benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.migration_category AS vm_state_migration_category FROM confirmed_ether60_migrations AS cem LEFT JOIN vm_state_migration_stats AS vms ON cem.instance_vm_state = vms.vm_state ORDER BY WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.max_memory_total * 1.0) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.total_vcpus, q1.total_memory_mb, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.max_memory_total, q2.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, q2.max_memory_total DESC NULLS LAST, q2.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_total_stddev, a.avg_memory_total_stddev, (c.memory_total_stddev - a.avg_memory_total_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.avg_memory_total_stddev, q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH top10_metadata_by_display_name AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) AS avg_metadata_entries FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_entries, ac.avg_metadata_entries, (ic.metadata_entries - ac.avg_metadata_entries) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_entries DESC NULLS LAST), high_memory_stddev_display_names AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), StddevAverage AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_display_names_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_memory_stddev_display_names) AS high_memory_stddev_display_names_count FROM top10_metadata_by_display_name
WITH top_projects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instances AS i2 ON ic.uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND ic.window_column = 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_rank1_instance_by_window FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ORDER BY total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), instance_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id NULLS FIRST) SELECT tp.project_id, tp.total_memory_mb, tp.has_rank1_instance_by_window, id.instance_id, id.instance_uuid, id.user_id, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.info_cache_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, id.total_instances_in_project, id.avg_instance_count FROM top_projects AS tp JOIN instance_details AS id ON id.project_id = tp.project_id ORDER BY tp.total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, id.instance_id NULLS FIRST
WITH RootDiskTotals AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50), avg_totals AS (SELECT AVG(total_root_gb) AS avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.total_root_gb, at.avg_total_root_gb, (ic.total_root_gb - at.avg_total_root_gb) AS deviation_from_avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_totals AS at), MigrationMemoryCVByImageType AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ism.value AS image_type, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ism.value ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedResults AS (SELECT rdt.DISPLAY_NAME AS entity_name, rdt.total_root_gb AS metric_value, 'High Total Root Disk (GB)' AS reason FROM RootDiskTotals AS rdt UNION ALL SELECT mmc.image_type AS entity_name, mmc.max_coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, 'Max Migration Memory Remaining CV (Completed Migrations)' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryCVByImageType AS mmc) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name NULLS FIRST
WITH migration_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.migration_status, i.instance_vm_state, i.migration_count, i.earliest_migration_created_at, (i.migration_count - a.avg_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), memory_variance_by_state AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac) SELECT ms.migration_status, ms.instance_vm_state, ms.migration_count, ms.earliest_migration_created_at, ms.deviation_from_avg_migration_count, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_variance_benchmark, mv.variance_category FROM migration_stats AS ms JOIN memory_variance_by_state AS mv ON ms.instance_vm_state = mv.VM_STATE
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.key, ic.value, ic.window_column, av.avg_window_min_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - av.avg_window_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS av), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), avg_variance AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT display_name, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_range_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), avg_cov AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov AS ac ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000), AvgTotals AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_total_memory_mb FROM AvgTotals)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY uuid NULLS FIRST) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, uuid, hostname, memory_mb, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) OVER () AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ORDER BY uuid NULLS FIRST) SELECT q2.uuid, q2.hostname, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.network_info, q2.window_column, q2.total_forge_instances, q2.avg_forge_memory_mb, q1.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY q2.uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances)) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, i.hostname FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_display_name_total_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS high_memory_instance_count, SUM(q1.total_memory_mb) AS high_memory_instances_total_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = q2.display_name JOIN q1 ON q1.uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY q2.display_name, q2.total_memory_mb ORDER BY shelved_offloaded_display_name_total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH az_image_type_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb > am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb < am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am), completed_migration_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), OverallBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT cte.DISPLAY_NAME, cte.avg_memory_mb, cte.memory_mb_variance, ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb > ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb < ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS cte CROSS JOIN OverallBenchmark AS ob ORDER BY cte.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM az_image_type_memory WHERE memory_category = 'HIGH_MEMORY') AS az_image_type_high_memory_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_migration_memory WHERE memory_category = 'HIGH_MEMORY') AS completed_migration_high_memory_count FROM az_image_type_memory AS aitm CROSS JOIN completed_migration_memory AS cmm LIMIT 1

inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM id.avg_instance_count, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM instance_details AS id JOIN memory_variances AS mv ON id.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY id.instance_id NULLS FIRST
WITH forge_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST), DisplayNameAverages AS (SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb NULLS FIRST), flare3_stddevs AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, av.avg_memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - av.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT COUNT(*) AS forge_instances_above_avg_memory_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare3_stddevs) AS flare3_display_names_with_stddev_count FROM forge_above_avg AS fa JOIN flare3_stddevs AS fs ON fs.display_name = fa.display_name

ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), metadata_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) a.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN INSTANCES AS t0 ON t0.UUID = i.UUID CROSS JOIN avg_ids AS a) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q2.hostname, q2.availability_zone, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.instance_extra_id, q1.instance_extra_created_at, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_instance_extra_id_window_3_preceding_1_following_by_memory_mb, q1.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_category, q2.rank_within_az_by_id, q2.deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.UUID = q1.instance_uuid
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, (CAST(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(totals.grand_total_memory_mb, 0)) AS pct_of_included_total_memory FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SUM(total_memory_mb) AS grand_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS totals ON 1 = 1), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.min_memory_mb > 0.75 * (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb, q1.total_memory_mb, q1.pct_of_included_total_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.VM_STATE = q1.VM_STATE ORDER BY q1.pct_of_included_total_memory DESC NULLS LAST, q2.instance_count DESC NULLS LAST, q2.DISPLAY_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH az_running_sum_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)), high_migration_memory_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > (SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed')) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, i.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid), flare3_high_migration_memory_instances AS (SELECT hmi.instance_uuid, hmi.display_name, hmi.total_memory_processed FROM high_migration_memory_instances AS hmi JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = hmi.instance_uuid WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM az_running_sum_above_avg) AS flare3_instances_running_sum_above_avg_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare3_high_migration_memory_instances) AS flare3_instances_high_migration_memory_count
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), avg_variance AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance AS av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.total_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), AvgStddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, a.avg_memory_mb_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev > a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev < a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AvgStddev AS a) SELECT q2.display_name, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS overall_memory_mb_stddev, q2.memory_mb_stddev AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb_stddev, q2.benchmark AS shelved_offloaded_stddev_benchmark, q2.variability_category FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST, q2.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH top10_by_avg_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT i.display_name, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = i.display_name GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.id = inner_cte.min_instance_id ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), display_name_memory_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, (c.memory_mb_range - a.avg_memory_mb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN avg_ranges AS a ORDER BY c.memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT t.display_name, t.min_instance_id, t.avg_memory_mb, t.has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows, s.memory_mb_range, s.memory_mb_variance, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM top10_by_avg_memory AS t JOIN display_name_memory_stats AS s ON s.display_name = t.display_name ORDER BY t.avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.window_column NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) = m.MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE m.MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST), Benchmark AS (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_memory_mb))) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark AS b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.migration_type, q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb_within_migration_type, q2.geometric_mean_memory_mb AS display_name_geometric_mean_memory_mb, q2.benchmark AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb, q2.memory_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.instance_display_name JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = q1.instance_uuid WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY q1.migration_type NULLS FIRST, q1.window_column NULLS FIRST, q1.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationWindowedInstances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY 'completed') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.window_column NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) = m.MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE m.MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > 5000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mwi.migration_type, mwi.instance_uuid, mwi.instance_display_name, mwi.migration_status, mwi.window_column, NULLS FIRST, mwi.window_column NULLS FIRST, mwi.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), VmStateAverages AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.VCPUS * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.vcpus > (SELECT vsa.avg_vcpus FROM VmStateAverages AS vsa WHERE vsa.vm_state = ic.vm_state)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), avg_variance AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance AS av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.window_column, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST, q1.display_name NULLS FIRST, q1.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, q1.window_column NULLS FIRST

WITH completed_migration_rank_by_zone AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT instance_availability_zone, MAX(window_column) AS max_migration_rank_in_zone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_availability_zone), max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY key_name) SELECT cmrz.max_migration_rank_in_zone, mtv.max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM completed_migration_rank_by_zone AS cmrz CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(max_total_vcpus_per_instance) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3) AS mtv WHERE cmrz.instance_availability_zone = 'flare3'
WITH MemoryRangeVariability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, ar.avg_memory_range_mb AS benchmark_memory_range_mb, CASE WHEN ac.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS deviation_from_avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac) SELECT iws.uuid, iws.display_name, iws.vm_state, iws.power_state, iws.memory_mb, iws.vcpus, iws.max_instance_extra_id_next2, iws.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2, iws.deviation_from_avg_max_next2, tdkg.key AS system_metadata_key, tdkg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tdkg.has_neon_value_for_key FROM InstanceWindowStats AS iws JOIN TopDisplayNameKeyGroups AS tdkg ON iws.display_name = tdkg.display_name ORDER BY tdkg.max_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, iws.uuid NULLS FIRST

window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND low_rank_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'AVERAGE_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_rank_instances FROM q1 JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = q1.display_name JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb ORDER BY q1.memory_range_mb DESC WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_uuid) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.vm_state) AS total_instances_in_vm_state, avg_counts.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(vm_state_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM (SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS vm_state_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.window_column, q2.total_instances_in_vm_state, q2.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS REAL)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS REAL) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VAR_SAMP(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, AVG(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.memory_total, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS instance_project_id, i.vcpus AS instance_vcpus, i.memory_mb AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total NULLS FIRST), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, MAX(instance_vcpus) AS max_instance_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE NULLS FIRST) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.source_compute, q1.dest_compute, q1.memory_total, q1.window_column AS avg_memory_total_window_2_pre_2_fol_by_az, q1.instance_project_id, q1.instance_vcpus, q1.instance_memory_mb, q2.max_instance_vcpus AS ether_18_completed_max_instance_vcpus_for_dest_compute FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.dest_compute = q2.dest_compute ORDER BY q1.memory_total NULLS FIRST
WITH migration_mem_window AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT uuid, display_name, source_compute, dest_compute, status, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)), instance_state_mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), avg_mem AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_mem AS am), counts AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM migration_mem_window) AS migration_rows_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instance_state_mem_stats) AS instance_rows_count) SELECT c.migration_rows_count, c.instance_rows_count FROM counts AS c
WITH metadata_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_cte AS v JOIN metadata_cte AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state NULLS FIRST, v.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, m.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, m.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH cov_results AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), avg_cov AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte, avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), memory_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT cr.display_name, cr.coefficient_of_variation, cr.avg_coefficient_of_variation, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM cov_results AS cr JOIN memory_stats AS ms ON cr.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY cr.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH metadata_rows AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_rows AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_rows AS v JOIN metadata_rows AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state NULLS FIRST, v.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, m.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, m.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VAR_SAMP(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VAR_SAMP(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), PerDisplayNameAvg AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(per_instance_meta.meta_entry_count) AS avg_meta_entries_per_instance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_meta_entries_per_instance) AS overall_avg_meta_entries FROM PerDisplayNameAvg) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, (pda.avg_meta_entries_per_instance - oa.overall_avg_meta_entries) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN PerDisplayNameAvg AS pda ON pda.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME CROSS JOIN OverallAvg AS oa ORDER BY ic.metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.metadata_count_range AS completed_migration_metadata_count_range, q1.metadata_count_variance AS completed_migration_metadata_count_variance, q1.metadata_count_stddev AS completed_migration_metadata_count_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.metadata_count_range AS per_instance_metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance AS per_instance_metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev AS per_instance_metadata_count_stddev, q2.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH sq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), sq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS mem_stats WHERE (CAST(inner_cte.MEMORY_MB * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(mem_stats.max_memory_mb, 0)) > 0.75) SELECT s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata, COUNT(s2.migration_id) AS completed_migration_rows_over_75pct_max_mem FROM sq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN sq2 AS s2 ON s2.DISPLAY_NAME = s1.DISPLAY_NAME GROUP BY s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata ORDER BY s1.avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, (CAST(inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(max_vals.max_min_memory_mb, 0)) AS min_memory_vs_max_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS max_vals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (CAST(inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(max_vals.max_min_memory_mb, 0)) >= 0.75), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VAR_SAMP(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC NULLS LAST), AverageRange AS (SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange AS ar ORDER BY ic.memory_total_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.min_memory_vs_max_ratio, q2.memory_total_range, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.benchmark AS avg_memory_total_range_benchmark, q2.variability_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.VM_STATE = q2.VM_STATE ORDER BY q2.memory_total_range DESC NULLS LAST, q1.instance_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12', (SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM (SELECT i.host AS host,
