WITH max_avg_mem_by_display_name AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(avg_memory_mb) AS max_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DISPLAY_NAME), stddev_mem_by_display_name AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_stddev, a.avg_memory_mb_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev > a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev < a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS a) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.max_avg_memory_mb, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.benchmark, s.variability_category FROM max_avg_mem_by_display_name AS m JOIN stddev_mem_by_display_name AS s ON m.DISPLAY_NAME = s.DISPLAY_NAME
WITH root_stats_by_display_name AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT imr.instance_uuid, imr.display_name, imr.memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.flavor, instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') ORDER BY UNION ALL SELECT n.instance_uuid, n.DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS VM_STATE, NULL AS MEMORY_MB, NULL AS VCPUS, NULL AS KEY_NAME, NULL AS instance_extra_id, n.NETWORK_INFO, 'High Cached Network Info Length vs Avg (flare3, name~flare)' AS Reason FROM NetworkInfoAboveAvg AS n) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstances ORDER BY instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_migration_id, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb, b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb > b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb < b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte AS b), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.metadata_records, q2.deviation_from_avg, q1.min_migration_id, q1.avg_instance_memory_mb, q1.benchmark, q1.memory_category FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.metadata_records DESC NULLS LAST

ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank AS ar), instance_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_in_state FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state) AS state_counts ON inner_cte.vm_state = state_counts.vm_state, (SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_instances_per_state FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state) AS sub) AS avg_state_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb NULLS FIRST) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.network_info, id.window_column AS memory_mb_window_avg, id.total_in_state, id.avg_instances_per_state, md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.flavor, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, md.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank, md.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS migration_dense_rank_deviation FROM instance_details AS id JOIN migration_details AS md ON id.display_name = md.display_name WHERE id.total_in_state > id.avg_instances_per_state ORDER BY id.memory_mb NULLS FIRST

INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST), vm_state_totals AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_vm_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE) SELECT q2.vm_state, q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.window_column q2.instance_uuid JOIN vm_state_totals AS vst ON vst.vm_state = q2.vm_state WHERE (CAST(vst.total_instances_in_vm_state * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(q1.total_rows_for_key, 0), 0)) > 0.75 WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_memory_mb, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migration_id NULLS FIRST), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT display_name, migrations FROM inner_cte WHERE migrations > (SELECT AVG(migrations) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migrations DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.migration_id, q1.instance_display_name, q1.instance_memory_mb, q1.window_column AS running_instance_memory_mb_within_status, q2.migrations AS completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.migrations DESC NULLS LAST, q1.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH cov_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), avg_cov AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), meta_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), AvgValueLen AS (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(metadata_value)) AS avg_value_len FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, av.avg_value_len AS benchmark, CASE WHEN LENGTH(ic.metadata_value) > av.avg_value_len * 1.5 THEN 'LONG_VALUE' WHEN LENGTH(ic.metadata_value) < av.avg_value_len * 0.5 THEN 'SHORT_VALUE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VALUE' END AS value_length_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AvgValueLen AS av) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.coefficient_of_variation, c.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation, m.metadata_value, m.NETWORK_INFO, m.benchmark AS avg_metadata_value_length_benchmark, m.value_length_category FROM meta_inner_cte AS m JOIN cov_inner_cte AS c ON c.display_name = m.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH memory_by_state AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.total_memory_mb, a.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > a.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < a.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), root_gb_by_state AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC NULLS LAST), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS benchmark_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.avg_root_gb, ic.root_gb_range, ic.root_gb_variance, b.benchmark_avg_root_gb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_root_gb > b.benchmark_avg_root_gb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROOT_GB' WHEN ic.avg_root_gb < b.benchmark_avg_root_gb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROOT_GB' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROOT_GB' END AS root_gb_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte AS b) SELECT mbs.VM_STATE, mbs.total_memory_mb, mbs.benchmark AS memory_benchmark, mbs.memory_category, rgs.avg_root_gb, rgs.root_gb_range, rgs.root_gb_variance, rgs.benchmark AS root_gb_benchmark, rgs.root_gb_category FROM memory_by_state AS mbs JOIN root_gb_by_state AS rgs ON mbs.VM_STATE = rgs.vm_state ORDER BY mbs.total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ism2.value) AS distinct_image_types FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), AverageVariance AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageVariance AS av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q1.distinct_image_types, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH mem_threshold AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), max_mem AS (SELECT MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, mm.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN max_mem AS mm WHERE (CAST(ic.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(mm.max_memory_mb, 0)) > 0.75 ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST), meta_network_deviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS REAL)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS REAL) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am) SELECT mt.display_name, mt.avg_memory_mb, mt.memory_mb_variance, mt.max_memory_mb, mnd.metadata_value, mnd.NETWORK_INFO, mnd.window_column, mnd.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM mem_threshold AS mt JOIN meta_network_deviation AS mnd ON mt.display_name = mnd.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY mt.avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, mnd.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), OverallMin AS (SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin AS om) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb, q1.instance_count AS image_image_type_instance_count, q2.instance_count AS high_vcpu_instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb AS high_vcpu_min_memory_mb, q2.min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.VM_STATE = q1.vm_state ORDER BY q2.VM_STATE NULLS FIRST, q2.DISPLAY_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationMemoryWindow AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_window AS aw), InstanceMemoryVarianceStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), avg_stats AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_variance - a.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_stats AS a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mmw.migration_id, mmw.instance_display_name, mmw.instance_memory_mb, mmw.running_sum_instance_memory_mb, mmw.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb, imvs.memory_mb_variance, imvs.memory_mb_stddev, imvs.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMemoryWindow AS mmw JOIN InstanceMemoryVarianceStats AS imvs ON mmw.instance_display_name = imvs.display_name ORDER BY mmw.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT NULLS FIRST), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedResults AS (SELECT instance_uuid AS entity_id, instance_display_name AS entity_name, metadata_key AS detail_key, metadata_value AS detail_value, network_info AS detail_blob, window_column AS metric_1, NULL AS metric_2, NULL AS metric_3, NULL AS metric_4, 'Image-type metadata rows with above-average windowed memory on host blaze8-12' AS reason FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS entity_id, inner_cte2.display_name AS entity_name, NULL AS detail_key, NULL AS detail_value, NULL AS detail_blob, inner_cte2.memory_mb_range AS metric_1, inner_cte2.memory_mb_variance AS metric_2, inner_cte2.memory_mb_stddev AS metric_3, avg_ranges.avg_memory_mb_range AS metric_4, 'Prime display names (not deleted) with memory spread stats' AS reason FROM inner_cte2, (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte2) AS avg_ranges) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason NULLS FIRST, metric_1 DESC NULLS LAST, entity_name NULLS FIRST, entity_id NULLS FIRST
WITH FlareNetworkInfoOutliers AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare'), NetworkInfoAverages AS (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) * 1.0) AS avg_network_info_len FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) > (SELECT avg_network_info_len FROM NetworkInfoAverages)), PrimeMigrationVariability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VAR_SAMP(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC NULLS LAST), AverageRange AS (SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ic.memory_total_stddev, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange AS ar), PrimeInstancesInFlare3 AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name FROM instances AS i WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime') SELECT pif.display_name, pmv.memory_total_range, pmv.memory_total_variance, pmv.memory_total_stddev, pmv.benchmark, pmv.variability_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT fno.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Above_Average_Flare_NetworkInfo_Length FROM PrimeInstancesInFlare3 AS pif JOIN PrimeMigrationVariability AS pmv ON pif.display_name = pmv.display_name LEFT JOIN FlareNetworkInfoOutliers AS fno ON pif.instance_uuid = fno.instance_uuid GROUP BY pif.display_name, pmv.memory_total_range, pmv.memory_total_variance, pmv.memory_total_stddev, pmv.benchmark, pmv.variability_category ORDER BY pmv.memory_total_range DESC NULLS LAST

WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12', (SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM (SELECT i.host AS host, (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type') SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type_count FROM flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type), flare3_migrations_detail AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VAR_SAMP(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedResults AS (SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.hostname, fim.metadata_key, fim.window_column, NULL AS migration_count_range, NULL AS migration_count_variance, NULL AS migration_count_stddev, 'Forge Instance Metadata' AS reason FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata AS fim UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS hostname, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS window_column, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, 'Migration Stats By Display Name' AS reason FROM MigrationStatsByDisplayName AS ms WHERE ms.display_name = 'forge') SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, hostname NULLS FIRST, metadata_key NULLS FIRST) SELECT icr.instance_uuid, icr.hostname, icr.metadata_key, icr.window_column, 'Above-key average running-sum (non-deleted cache only)' AS reason FROM inner_cte AS icr JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = icr.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE icr.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic.deleted = 0 AND icr.window_column > (SELECT AVG(icr2.window_column * 1.0) FROM inner_cte AS icr2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = icr2.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic2 ON ic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE icr2.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND icr2.metadata_key = icr.metadata_key) ORDER BY icr.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, icr.window_column NULLS FIRST, icr.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.UUID AS instance_uuid, f.HOSTNAME AS hostname, s.display_name, s.project_id, s.power_state, s.metadata_key, s.metadata_value, f.VM_STATE AS vm_state, f.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, f.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, s.max_memory_mb_next_2, f.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS s ON s.instance_uuid = f.UUID ORDER BY f.UUID NULLS FIRST, s.metadata_key NULLS FIRST), InstanceVcpu AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.VCPUS AS vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i), AverageVcpu AS (SELECT AVG(v.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus FROM InstanceVcpu AS v JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.display_name, ic.project_id, ic.power_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.max_memory_mb_next_2, ic.min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, v.vcpus, (v.vcpus - WITH inner_cte AS (WITH top_metadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), completed_migrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_availability_zone, cm.migration_status, cm.window_column, tm.metadata_entries FROM completed_migrations AS cm JOIN top_metadata AS tm ON tm.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY tm.metadata_entries DESC NULLS LAST, cm.migration_id NULLS FIRST) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_availability_zone, migration_status, window_column, metadata_entries FROM inner_cte WHERE metadata_entries > (SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC NULLS LAST, migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq2.completed_migrations, sq1.uuid, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.key_name, sq1.instance_extra_id, sq1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.completed_migrations DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), subq2 AS (SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances)) SELECT subq1.instance_uuid, subq1.hostname, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column, subq2.total_memory_mb FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.instance_uuid = subq2.uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, subq1.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, subq1.window_column NULLS FIRST) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.hostname, c.metadata_key, c.window_column, c.total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN NOT ic.instance_uuid IS NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_info_cache FROM inner_cte AS c LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON ic.instance_uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, c.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, c.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), NonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ndm.INSTANCE_UUID, ndm.FLAVOR, ndm.KEY, ndm.window_column FROM MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms JOIN NonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS ndm ON ndm.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = ndm.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT inner_cte.KEY, MAX(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) AS max_avg_memory_mb, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev_for_max_avg, MAX(inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID) AS instance_uuid_for_max_avg, MAX(inner_cte.FLAVOR) AS flavor_for_max_avg, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS dense_rank_for_max_avg FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'), sq2 AS (SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.availability_zone, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.uuid, sq1.max_metadata_id_next_2, sq2.status AS migration_status, sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM sq1 JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = sq1.uuid JOIN sq2 ON sq2.status = m.status JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i2.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i2.memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, sq1.uuid NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.max_metadata_id_next_2, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, m2.source_compute, m2.dest_compute, MAX(m2.id) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.uuid NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_migration_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = inner_cte.uuid JOIN instances AS i3 ON i3.uuid = inner_cte.uuid WHERE i3.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i3.memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT imcv.display_name, imcv.coefficient_of_variation, soms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceMemoryCV AS imcv JOIN ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStddev AS soms ON imcv.display_name = soms.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), AverageCV AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageCV AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST

MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS s ON d.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name NULLS FIRST, d.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, d.metadata_id NULLS FIRST) SELECT ic.instance_id, MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VAR_SAMP(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN (SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName AS (SELECT cm.instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name) SELECT cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName AS cmpdn JOIN InstanceCacheStats AS ics ON cmpdn.instance_display_name = ics.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN CompletedMigrations AS cm ON cm.instance_display_name = cmpdn.instance_display_name WHERE (CAST(cmpdn.completed_migration_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((cmpdn.completed_migration_count + ics.cache_count_range), 0)) > 0.75 GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev ORDER BY cmpdn.completed_migration_count DESC NULLS LAST), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, (ic.completed_migration_count - 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST), InstanceCompletedMigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT w.uuid, w.display_name, w.vm_state, w.memory_mb, w.network_info, w.window_column, s.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, s.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY display_name) AS dn) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, AS flavor_json, NULL AS numa_topology_json, NULL AS network_info_json, NULL AS window_column, pms.memory_total_stddev, 'Prime Migration Memory Stddev' AS reason FROM PrimeMigrationStddev AS pms) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason NULLS FIRST, display_name NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) SELECT ic.*, COUNT(ism2.id) AS image_image_type_metadata_rows FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VmStateMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), ActiveMigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND NOT m.status IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state) SELECT ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb, vsmv.memory_mb_variance FROM ActiveMigrationStats AS ams JOIN VmStateMemoryVariance AS vsmv ON ams.instance_vm_state = vsmv.VM_STATE ORDER BY ams.migration_count DESC NULLS LAST, vsmv.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), avg_variance AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.migration_count, ic.min_instance_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance AS av ORDER BY ic.migration_count DESC NULLS LAST, ic.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), VMStateMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VAR_SAMP(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND NOT m.STATUS IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC NULLS LAST), VMStateTotalInstances AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE) SELECT vsmv.VM_STATE, vsmv.memory_total_variance, vsti.total_instance_count FROM VMStateMemoryVariance AS vsmv JOIN VMStateTotalInstances AS vsti ON vsmv.VM_STATE = vsti.VM_STATE WHERE (CAST(vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(vsti.total_instance_count, 0)) > (SELECT AVG(dnms.memory_total_stddev) FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS dnms) ORDER BY (CAST(vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(vsti.total_instance_count, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST), AverageVariancePerInstance AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(inner_cte.total_instance_count, 0)) AS avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, inner_cte.total_instance_count, (CAST(inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(inner_cte.total_instance_count, 0)) AS variance_per_instance, ((CAST(inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(inner_cte.total_instance_count, 0)) - avpi.avg_variance_per_instance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN AverageVariancePerInstance AS avpi ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH migration_details AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST), instance_details AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), host_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT id.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM migration_details AS md CROSS JOIN instance_details AS id) SELECT hs.completed_migration_count, hs.active_instance_count FROM host_summary AS hs), HostActiveInstances AS (SELECT i.host, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND NOT i.host IS NULL AND i.host <> '' GROUP BY i.host), AverageHostInstances AS (SELECT AVG(active_instance_count) AS avg_active_instances FROM HostActiveInstances) SELECT 'blaze8-12' AS host, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.active_instance_count, ahi.avg_active_instances AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.active_instance_count > ahi.avg_active_instances * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' WHEN ic.active_instance_count < ahi.avg_active_instances * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION' END AS utilization_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageHostInstances AS ahi

WITH ForgeInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY ie.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMetaStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VAR_SAMP(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN (SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column, dms.meta_count_range, dms.meta_count_variance, dms.meta_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceWindow AS fiw JOIN DisplayNameMetaStats AS dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationMemoryStatsByVMState AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VAR_SAMP(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC NULLS LAST), InstanceMemoryStatsWithPCIRequestsByVMState AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mms.VM_STATE AS vm_state, mms.memory_total_range, mms.memory_total_variance, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_range, ims.memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMemoryStatsByVMState AS mms JOIN InstanceMemoryStatsWithPCIRequestsByVMState AS ims ON mms.VM_STATE = ims.vm_state ORDER BY mms.memory_total_range DESC NULLS LAST

WITH MigrationStatusMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), CompletedFlare3InstanceMemoryRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT msms.status AS migration_status, msms.avg_instance_memory_mb, msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev, AVG(cfis.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb_within_migration_type FROM MigrationStatusMemoryStats AS msms JOIN CompletedFlare3InstanceMemoryRunningSum AS cfis ON msms.status = cfis.migration_status GROUP BY msms.status, msms.avg_instance_memory_mb, msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST

WITH forge_instances_window AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.key ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge'), display_name_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT fiw.uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.key, fiw.value, fiw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM forge_instances_window AS fiw JOIN display_name_memory_stats AS dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge'
WITH MigrationWindowedMemory AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST), InstanceMigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mwm.migration_id, mwm.source_compute, mwm.dest_compute, mwm.dest_host, mwm.display_name, mwm.memory_mb, mwm.window_column AS avg_instance_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following, imcv.coefficient_of_variation AS memory_remaining_coefficient_of_variation_for_instance FROM MigrationWindowedMemory AS mwm JOIN InstanceMigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS imcv ON mwm.display_name = imcv.display_name WHERE imcv.coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, mwm.migration_id NULLS FIRST

WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), NonDeletedInstanceWindowStats AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT cmd.migration_id, cmd.INSTANCE_UUID, cmd.MIGRATION_TYPE, cmd.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmd.DEST_COMPUTE, cmd.DEST_HOST, cmd.DISPLAY_NAME AS migration_instance_display_name, cmd.VM_STATE AS migration_instance_vm_state, cmd.MEMORY_MB AS migration_instance_memory_mb, cmd.VCPUS AS migration_instance_vcpus, cmd.instance_extra_id AS migration_instance_extra_id, cmd.MEMORY_TOTAL, cmd.window_column AS min_memory_total_within_migration_type, nis.power_state AS nondeleted_instance_power_state, nis.max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM CompletedMigrationDetails AS cmd JOIN NonDeletedInstanceWindowStats AS nis ON cmd.INSTANCE_UUID = nis.uuid ORDER BY cmd.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST, cmd.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH ForgeWindowRanks AS (SELECT i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY i.memory_mb NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge'), HighRootGbInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.UUID HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > (SELECT AVG(ROOT_GB) + STDDEV(ROOT_GB) FROM INSTANCES)) SELECT fwr.uuid AS instance_uuid, fwr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, hri.total_root_gb FROM ForgeWindowRanks AS fwr JOIN HighRootGbInstances AS hri ON hri.instance_uuid = fwr.uuid ORDER BY fwr.window_column NULLS FIRST, fwr.uuid NULLS FIRST

WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS (SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VAR_SAMP(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC NULLS LAST
WITH TcpRuleStats AS (SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS total_to_port FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION), GeoMeanPortRange AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, EXP(AVG(LN(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1))) AS geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.TO_PORT >= sgr.FROM_PORT GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_port_range_size DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics AS (SELECT t.security_group_id, t.security_group_name, t.security_group_description, t.rule_count, t.total_to_port, g.geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM TcpRuleStats AS t JOIN GeoMeanPortRange AS g ON t.security_group_name = g.security_group_name) SELECT security_group_id, security_group_name, security_group_description, rule_count, total_to_port, geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics ORDER BY security_group_name NULLS FIRST
