WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0), InstanceMetadataAgg AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT idt.instance_id, idt.instance_uuid, idt.user_id, idt.project_id, idt.display_name, idt.vm_state, idt.memory_mb, idt.vcpus, idt.info_cache_id, idt.max_instance_id_next_2, ima.availability_zone, ima.metadata_entry_count, ima.total_vcpus FROM InstanceDetails AS idt JOIN InstanceMetadataAgg AS ima ON idt.instance_uuid = ima.instance_uuid ORDER BY idt.instance_id NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceWindowRanks AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT iwr.instance_uuid, i.display_name, iwr.metadata_value, iwr.window_column, dnms.avg_memory_mb, dnms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceWindowRanks AS iwr JOIN instances AS i ON iwr.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats AS dnms ON i.display_name = dnms.display_name WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY dnms.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST, iwr.window_column NULLS FIRST, iwr.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceMemoryMetadataVariance AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), InstanceMemoryRangeAndVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT imv.DISPLAY_NAME, imv.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance, imrv.memory_range_mb, imrv.memory_variance_mb FROM InstanceMemoryMetadataVariance AS imv JOIN InstanceMemoryRangeAndVariance AS imrv ON imv.DISPLAY_NAME = imrv.display_name ORDER BY imrv.memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH ImageTypeMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), KeyNameNotDeletedMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT itms.display_name, itms.avg_memory_mb, itms.memory_mb_variance, kndms.memory_range_mb, kndms.memory_variance_mb FROM ImageTypeMemoryStats AS itms JOIN KeyNameNotDeletedMemoryStats AS kndms ON itms.display_name = kndms.display_name WHERE itms.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY itms.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH AZInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), NotDeletedInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), CombinedInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column, 'Availability Zone flare3' AS reason FROM AZInstances UNION ALL SELECT ndi.uuid AS instance_uuid, ndi.display_name AS display_name, NULL AS vm_state, NULL AS memory_mb, NULL AS vcpus, ndi.key AS metadata_key, ndi.value AS metadata_value, ndi.window_column AS window_column, 'Not Deleted (DELETED = 0)' AS reason FROM NotDeletedInstances AS ndi) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceMetadata ORDER BY instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, metadata_key NULLS FIRST, reason NULLS FIRST
WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sohdn.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS cmwm LEFT JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS sohdn ON cmwm.instance_display_name = sohdn.display_name GROUP BY cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC NULLS LAST, cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE NULLS FIRST
WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0), q2 AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed') SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.info_cache_id, q1.max_instance_id_next_2, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid ORDER BY q1.instance_id NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), CompletedMigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT cmm.migration_id, cmm.instance_uuid, cmm.source_compute, cmm.dest_compute, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.metadata_key, cmm.metadata_value, cmm.window_column, imv.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationMetadata AS cmm JOIN InstanceMemoryVariance AS imv ON cmm.instance_display_name = imv.display_name ORDER BY cmm.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceMigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), DisplayNameMigrationMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT imw.instance_uuid, imw.instance_display_name, imw.migration_status, imw.window_column, dcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationWindow AS imw JOIN DisplayNameMigrationMemoryCV AS dcv ON imw.instance_display_name = dcv.display_name ORDER BY dcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, imw.instance_display_name NULLS FIRST, imw.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationMetadataWindow AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mmw.migration_id, mmw.instance_display_name, mmw.metadata_key, mmw.window_column, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMetadataWindow AS mmw JOIN InstanceMemoryStats AS ims ON mmw.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY mmw.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, mmw.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ForgeInstanceMetadataExtra AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.KEY AS metadata_key, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, t0.CREATED_AT AS extra_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), CompletedMigrationsForForge AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.metadata_key, cm.window_column AS completed_migrations_running_sum, fime.instance_uuid, fime.metadata_value, fime.extra_created_at, fime.window_column AS forge_metadata_row_number FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name JOIN ForgeInstanceMetadataExtra AS fime ON fime.instance_uuid = i.UUID AND fime.metadata_key = cm.metadata_key) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, metadata_key, completed_migrations_running_sum, instance_uuid, metadata_value, extra_created_at, forge_metadata_row_number FROM CompletedMigrationsForForge
WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), q2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_mb_variance AS host_blaze8_12_memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS host_blaze8_12_memory_mb_stddev, q2.avg_memory_mb AS prime_image_type_avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance AS prime_image_type_memory_mb_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, MIN(md.window_column) AS Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN MigrationRanks AS mr ON md.migration_id = mr.migration_id GROUP BY md.MIGRATION_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC NULLS LAST, md.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST
WITH az_host_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST), non_deleted_host_instances AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_instance_count, AVG(az.window_column) AS avg_running_avg_memory_mb_in_az, AVG(nd.max_instance_id_next_2) AS avg_max_instance_id_next_2 FROM az_host_instances AS az JOIN non_deleted_host_instances AS nd ON az.instance_uuid = nd.instance_uuid
WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST), VmStateHighTotalMemory AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12')) SELECT vhtm.vm_state, vhtm.total_memory_mb, vmgmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM VmStateHighTotalMemory AS vhtm JOIN VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS vmgmm ON vhtm.vm_state = vmgmm.vm_state ORDER BY vhtm.total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH top_cache AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), host_instances AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT hi.display_name, tc.cache_records, hi.vm_state, hi.memory_mb, hi.network_info, hi.window_column FROM top_cache AS tc JOIN host_instances AS hi ON tc.display_name = hi.display_name ORDER BY tc.cache_records DESC NULLS LAST
WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), q2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_variance AS completed_migrations_memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_range_mb, q2.memory_variance_mb AS active_keyed_instances_memory_variance_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.memory_range_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH migration_memory_stddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), instance_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT COUNT(*) AS prime_display_names_with_both_stats_count FROM migration_memory_stddev AS mms JOIN instance_memory_stats AS ims ON mms.display_name = ims.display_name
WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), sq2 AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime') SELECT sq2.migration_id, sq2.instance_display_name, sq1.memory_mb_variance, sq2.metadata_key, sq2.metadata_value, sq2.window_column FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.instance_display_name = sq1.display_name WHERE sq2.metadata_key = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY sq1.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST, sq2.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationWindow AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imw.metadata_key, COUNT(DISTINCT mw.migration_id) AS completed_migrations_on_blaze8_12, AVG(imw.window_column) AS avg_instance_memory_window_by_key, MAX(mw.max_memory_mb_next_2) AS max_of_migration_next2_memory_window FROM MigrationWindow AS mw JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = mw.display_name AND i.vm_state = mw.vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw ON imw.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY imw.metadata_key ORDER BY completed_migrations_on_blaze8_12 DESC NULLS LAST, imw.metadata_key NULLS FIRST
WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), q2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.image_type_value, q1.cache_record_count, q1.total_memory_mb, q2.coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH InstanceMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.VM_STATE, imr.KEY AS system_metadata_key, imr.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, imr.window_column AS metadata_rank_within_key, msd.memory_total_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataRanks AS imr JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS msd ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = msd.display_name ORDER BY msd.memory_total_stddev DESC NULLS LAST, imr.KEY NULLS FIRST, imr.window_column NULLS FIRST, imr.UUID NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceExtraStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info), CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ies.instance_uuid, ies.display_name, ies.network_info, ies.extra_record_count, ies.total_memory_mb, cm.migration_id, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status FROM InstanceExtraStats AS ies JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ies.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS cm ON cm.migration_id = m.id ORDER BY ies.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, cm.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH HostImageTypeCacheStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), TopPrimeCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY migration_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT h.instance_uuid, h.display_name, h.image_type_value, h.cache_record_count, h.total_memory_mb, NULL AS migration_count, 'Host blaze8-12 image_image_type + cache stats' AS reason FROM HostImageTypeCacheStats AS h UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, t.display_name, NULL AS image_type_value, NULL AS cache_record_count, NULL AS total_memory_mb, t.migration_count, 'Top completed migrations for prime display names (non-deleted cache)' AS reason FROM TopPrimeCompletedMigrations AS t) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason NULLS FIRST, display_name NULLS FIRST, instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare'), MetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT mw.instance_uuid, mw.instance_display_name, mw.migration_status, mw.window_column AS migration_memory_running_sum, md.KEY AS system_metadata_key, md.window_column AS instance_id_running_sum_within_key FROM MigrationWindow AS mw JOIN MetadataWindow AS md ON mw.instance_uuid = md.UUID ORDER BY mw.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, md.KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationCounts AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), GeometricMeanMemory AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mc.display_name, mc.migrations, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM MigrationCounts AS mc JOIN GeometricMeanMemory AS gmm ON mc.display_name = gmm.display_name ORDER BY mc.migrations DESC NULLS LAST
WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare') SELECT md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.network_info, md.window_column AS migration_status_dense_rank, imd.instance_uuid, imd.vm_state, imd.memory_mb, imd.vcpus, imd.metadata_key, imd.metadata_value, imd.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN InstanceMetadataDetails AS imd ON md.display_name = imd.display_name
WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS (SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, cmm.status, cmm.max_memory_total, cmm.created_at FROM InstanceMemoryStats AS ims JOIN CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS cmm ON ims.display_name = cmm.display_name
WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000), sq2 AS (SELECT i.availability_zone, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.availability_zone HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0)) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.launched_at, sq1.max_memory_mb, sq2.availability_zone, sq2.total_memory_mb FROM sq1 CROSS JOIN sq2 ORDER BY sq2.total_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, sq1.max_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH InstanceMetadataAndWindowMax AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndDenseRank AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imwm.instance_uuid, imwm.display_name, imwm.vm_state, imwm.power_state, imwm.memory_mb, imwm.vcpus, imwm.metadata_key, imwm.metadata_value, ifdr.FLAVOR AS instance_extra_flavor_json, ifdr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_metadata_key, imwm.max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM InstanceMetadataAndWindowMax AS imwm JOIN InstanceFlavorAndDenseRank AS ifdr ON imwm.instance_uuid = ifdr.INSTANCE_UUID AND imwm.metadata_key = ifdr.KEY ORDER BY imwm.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, imwm.metadata_key NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceMemoryDenseRank AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), InstanceNetworkAndAvgMemory AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT NULLS FIRST) SELECT imdr.instance_uuid, imdr.metadata_value, imdr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, inam.instance_display_name, inam.metadata_key, inam.network_info, inam.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window FROM InstanceMemoryDenseRank AS imdr JOIN InstanceNetworkAndAvgMemory AS inam ON imdr.instance_uuid = inam.instance_uuid AND imdr.metadata_value = inam.metadata_value ORDER BY imdr.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH windowed_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare'), host_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM windowed_instances) AS flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_memory_stats) AS blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM windowed_instances AS wi CROSS JOIN host_memory_stats AS hms LIMIT 1
WITH vm_state_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), active_migration_stats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND NOT m.status IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 AS (SELECT ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb FROM active_migration_stats AS ams JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = ams.instance_vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb) SELECT vsm.VM_STATE, vsm.memory_mb_variance, vsm.memory_mb_stddev, amsb.migration_status, amsb.migration_count, amsb.min_instance_memory_mb FROM vm_state_memory_stats AS vsm LEFT JOIN active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 AS amsb ON amsb.instance_vm_state = vsm.VM_STATE ORDER BY vsm.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST, amsb.migration_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH completed_migrations_per_instance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), instance_memory_stats_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.availability_zone, c.completed_migration_count, c.total_memory_processed, s.min_instance_id, s.avg_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations_per_instance AS c JOIN instance_memory_stats_by_display_name AS s ON c.instance_display_name = s.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.completed_migration_count DESC NULLS LAST, c.total_memory_processed DESC NULLS LAST
WITH MemoryStatsByMigrationStatus AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE NOT i.memory_mb IS NULL AND NOT m.status IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), ActiveMigrationDetailsWithWindowMax AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, ism.key, ism.value, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND NOT m.status IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')) SELECT amd.status, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, amd.source_compute, amd.dest_compute, amd.dest_host, amd.instance_uuid, amd.display_name, amd.vm_state, amd.key, amd.value, amd.max_memory_mb_next2 FROM ActiveMigrationDetailsWithWindowMax AS amd JOIN MemoryStatsByMigrationStatus AS ms ON amd.status = ms.status
WITH BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS AS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) AS Ether_Completed_Migration_Count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT bcm.DISPLAY_NAME) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Blaze8_12_Completed_Migration_To_Same_Dest_Compute FROM EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ecmwm LEFT JOIN BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations AS bcm ON ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE = bcm.DEST_COMPUTE GROUP BY ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Ether_Completed_Migration_Count DESC NULLS LAST, ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), subq2 AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT subq2.UUID AS instance_uuid, subq2.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, subq2.VM_STATE, subq2.MEMORY_MB, subq2.VCPUS, subq2.KEY_NAME, subq2.instance_extra_id, subq2.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, subq1.availability_zone AS migration_availability_zone, subq1.status AS migration_status, subq1.migration_type, subq1.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_instance_uuid FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.UUID = subq1.uuid ORDER BY subq2.UUID NULLS FIRST, subq1.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), VMStateVariation AS (SELECT i.vm_state, CAST(STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), VMStateMigrationCounts AS (SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state) SELECT md.migration_id, md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.max_memory_mb_next_2, vsv.coefficient_of_variation, vsmc.completed_migration_count FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN VMStateVariation AS vsv ON md.vm_state = vsv.vm_state JOIN VMStateMigrationCounts AS vsmc ON md.vm_state = vsmc.vm_state WHERE (CAST(vsmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(completed_migration_count) FROM VMStateMigrationCounts), 0)) > 0.10 ORDER BY vsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, md.migration_id NULLS FIRST
WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), NonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT dms.DISPLAY_NAME, dms.memory_mb_stddev, ndm.INSTANCE_UUID, ndm.FLAVOR, ndm.KEY AS system_metadata_key, ndm.window_column FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS dms JOIN NonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS ndm ON ndm.DISPLAY_NAME = dms.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE ndm.KEY = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY dms.memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST, ndm.DISPLAY_NAME NULLS FIRST, ndm.INSTANCE_UUID NULLS FIRST
WITH memory_stats_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND iic.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST), root_disk_stats_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ms.vm_state, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, rs.avg_root_gb, rs.root_gb_range, rs.root_gb_variance FROM memory_stats_by_vm_state AS ms JOIN root_disk_stats_by_vm_state AS rs ON rs.VM_STATE = ms.vm_state
WITH PrimeCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), HostBlazeInstances AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT pcm.DISPLAY_NAME, pcm.min_migration_id, pcm.avg_instance_memory_mb, hbi.instance_id, hbi.instance_uuid, hbi.user_id, hbi.project_id, hbi.vm_state, hbi.memory_mb, hbi.vcpus, hbi.info_cache_id, hbi.max_instance_id_next_2 FROM PrimeCompletedMigrations AS pcm JOIN HostBlazeInstances AS hbi ON hbi.display_name = pcm.DISPLAY_NAME
WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), sq2 AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare') SELECT sq2.migration_id, sq2.migration_status, sq2.source_compute, sq2.dest_compute, sq2.instance_uuid, sq2.instance_display_name, sq2.instance_memory_mb, sq2.instance_extra_id, sq2.window_column, sq1.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.instance_display_name = sq1.display_name JOIN instances AS i2 ON sq2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY sq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, sq2.migration_id NULLS FIRST

WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT md.uuid AS instance_uuid, md.display_name, md.availability_zone, md.status AS migration_status, md.migration_type, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN InstanceMetadataStats AS ims ON md.uuid = ims.instance_uuid WHERE md.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY md.display_name NULLS FIRST, md.uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), TopMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), CombinedInstanceView AS (SELECT tm.display_name, tm.migrations, is1.min_instance_id, is1.avg_memory_mb, 'Top 10 by completed migrations' AS reason FROM TopMigrations AS tm LEFT JOIN InstanceStats AS is1 ON tm.display_name = is1.display_name UNION ALL SELECT is2.display_name, NULL AS migrations, is2.min_instance_id, is2.avg_memory_mb, 'Has image_image_type system metadata on blaze8-12 (not deleted)' AS reason FROM InstanceStats AS is2) SELECT display_name, migrations, min_instance_id, avg_memory_mb, reason FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY display_name NULLS FIRST, reason NULLS FIRST
