WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VAR_SAMP(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.metadata_count_range, m.metadata_count_variance, m.metadata_count_stddev, s.memory_mb_stddev FROM MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS m JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS s ON m.DISPLAY_NAME = s.display_name ORDER BY m.metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH RootGBStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC NULLS LAST), MigrationCountStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VAR_SAMP(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), Prime35MigrationCountStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VAR_SAMP(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name) SELECT rgs.DISPLAY_NAME, rgs.root_gb_range, rgs.root_gb_variance, pmcs.migration_count_range, pmcs.migration_count_variance, pmcs.migration_count_stddev FROM RootGBStats AS rgs JOIN Prime35MigrationCountStats AS pmcs ON rgs.DISPLAY_NAME = pmcs.display_name ORDER BY rgs.root_gb_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationMemoryStatsOnHost AS (SELECT m.status, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.display_name, cm.availability_zone, cm.status, cm.migration_type, cm.uuid, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS cm JOIN MigrationMemoryStatsOnHost AS ms ON cm.status = ms.status) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY status NULLS FIRST, uuid NULLS FIRST, window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq2.key AS system_metadata_key, sq1.min_migration_id, sq1.avg_instance_memory_mb, sq2.max_memory_mb FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.max_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST, sq2.display_name NULLS FIRST, sq2.key NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateMigrationVariance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VAR_SAMP(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND NOT m.STATUS IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.window_column, smv.memory_total_variance FROM InstanceDetails AS id LEFT JOIN StateMigrationVariance AS smv ON id.vm_state = smv.VM_STATE ORDER BY id.vm_state NULLS FIRST, id.window_column NULLS FIRST, id.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name ~ 'flare'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON imw.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY imw.display_name NULLS FIRST, imw.uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH vm_state_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST), vm_state_displayname_counts AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT vms.VM_STATE, vms.avg_memory_mb, vms.memory_mb_range, vms.memory_mb_variance, vdc.DISPLAY_NAME, vdc.instance_count, vdc.min_memory_mb FROM vm_state_memory_stats AS vms JOIN vm_state_displayname_counts AS vdc ON vdc.VM_STATE = vms.VM_STATE ORDER BY vms.memory_mb_range DESC NULLS LAST, vdc.instance_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH completed_migrations_on_blaze AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), flare3_instances_metadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fim.instance_uuid) AS flare3_instance_count FROM completed_migrations_on_blaze AS cm CROSS JOIN flare3_instances_metadata AS fim
WITH FlareZoneInstances AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name ~ 'flare'), HostImageTypeDenseRanks AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT fzi.display_name, fzi.availability_zone, fzi.vm_state, fzi.memory_mb, fzi.vcpus, fzi.uuid AS instance_uuid, fzi.max_metadata_id_next_2, hir.window_column AS dense_rank_memory_window FROM FlareZoneInstances AS fzi JOIN HostImageTypeDenseRanks AS hir ON fzi.uuid = hir.instance_uuid WHERE fzi.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY fzi.uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMigrationCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.VM_STATE, imr.KEY, imr.VALUE, imr.window_column, imcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMetadataRanks AS imr JOIN InstanceMigrationCV AS imcv ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = imcv.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, imr.UUID NULLS FIRST, imr.KEY NULLS FIRST, imr.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH TopMetadataDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), Flare3BlazeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), TopMetadataInstancesOnPrime35 AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME IN (SELECT DISPLAY_NAME FROM TopMetadataDisplayNames)) SELECT f.UUID, f.DISPLAY_NAME, f.VM_STATE, f.MEMORY_MB, f.VCPUS, f.KEY_NAME, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column FROM Flare3BlazeInstances AS f WHERE f.DISPLAY_NAME IN (SELECT DISPLAY_NAME FROM TopMetadataDisplayNames) ORDER BY f.VCPUS NULLS FIRST, f.UUID NULLS FIRST
WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), HighMemoryProcessedInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > (SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations)) SELECT c.display_name, c.availability_zone, c.status, c.migration_type, c.uuid, c.window_column, h.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS c JOIN HighMemoryProcessedInstances AS h ON c.uuid = h.instance_uuid
WITH MigrationStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status), MetadataWindowStats AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ms.instance_uuid, ms.instance_display_name, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.total_memory_processed, mws.KEY AS system_metadata_key, mws.window_column FROM MigrationStats AS ms JOIN MetadataWindowStats AS mws ON ms.instance_uuid = mws.UUID ORDER BY ms.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST, ms.migration_status NULLS FIRST, mws.KEY NULLS FIRST, mws.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH geometric_mean_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST), min_id_and_avg_memory_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT g.display_name, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, m.min_instance_id, m.avg_memory_mb FROM geometric_mean_by_display_name AS g JOIN min_id_and_avg_memory_by_display_name AS m ON g.display_name = m.display_name ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH PerInstanceMetadataDispersion AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VAR_SAMP(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), AllPrimeCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime') SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, pimd.metadata_count_range, pimd.metadata_count_variance, pimd.metadata_count_stddev FROM TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm JOIN PerInstanceMetadataDispersion AS pimd ON tcm.display_name = pimd.display_name JOIN (SELECT instance_uuid, COUNT(migration_id) AS total_completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM AllPrimeCompletedMigrations GROUP BY instance_uuid) AS apcm ON apcm.instance_uuid IN (SELECT i.uuid FROM instances AS i WHERE i.display_name = tcm.display_name AND i.display_name ~ 'prime') WHERE (CAST(tcm.completed_migrations * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(apcm.total_completed_migrations_for_display_name, 0)) > 0.75 ORDER BY tcm.completed_migrations DESC NULLS LAST
WITH InstanceNetworkCache AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.DISPLAY_NAME, inc.vm_state, inc.memory_mb, inc.network_info, ifm.FLAVOR, ifm.KEY, inc.window_column AS project_dense_rank, ifm.window_column AS metadata_key_dense_rank FROM InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS ifm JOIN InstanceNetworkCache AS inc ON ifm.DISPLAY_NAME = inc.display_name ORDER BY ifm.INSTANCE_UUID NULLS FIRST, ifm.KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceMetadataRows AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare'), HighMemoryVmStates AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT imr.instance_uuid, imr.display_name, imr.vm_state, imr.memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.metadata_key, imr.metadata_value, imr.window_column, hms.total_memory_mb FROM InstanceMetadataRows AS imr JOIN HighMemoryVmStates AS hms ON imr.vm_state = hms.VM_STATE ORDER BY imr.vm_state NULLS FIRST, imr.metadata_key NULLS FIRST, imr.window_column NULLS FIRST, imr.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), DisplayNameMetaStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VAR_SAMP(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN (SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT d.instance_uuid, d.display_name, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.instance_extra_id, d.max_instance_id_next_2, ms.meta_count_range, ms.meta_count_variance, ms.meta_count_stddev FROM InstanceDetails AS d JOIN DisplayNameMetaStats AS ms ON ms.display_name = d.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name NULLS FIRST, d.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST
WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), ImageTypeMetadata AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, itm.metadata_value, itm.network_info, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, itm.window_column AS image_type_row_number FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN ImageTypeMetadata AS itm ON md.display_name = itm.display_name ORDER BY md.display_name NULLS FIRST, itm.metadata_value NULLS FIRST
WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq1.status AS migration_status, sq1.max_memory_total, sq2.avg_memory_mb, sq2.memory_mb_variance FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare' ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(CAST(AVG(hcm.VCPUS) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(CAST(AVG(hcm.window_column) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(CAST(AVG(fcm.window_column) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE hcm.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare' GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS cm LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id NULLS FIRST, DISPLAY_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), Flare3FlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare') SELECT r.display_name, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_stddev, f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor_json, f.numa_topology_json, f.network_info_json, f.window_column FROM RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS r JOIN Flare3FlareInstances AS f ON f.display_name = r.display_name ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH migration_details AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, CAST(STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, md.window_column, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM migration_details AS md JOIN root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS rgb ON md.display_name = rgb.display_name
WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name ~ 'flare'), VMStateGeoMean AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT id.display_name, id.availability_zone, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.uuid, id.max_metadata_id_next_2, vmg.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM InstanceDetails AS id LEFT JOIN VMStateGeoMean AS vmg ON id.vm_state = vmg.vm_state
WITH Prime35InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST), Blaze812InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VAR_SAMP(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT p.display_name, p.memory_mb_variance AS prime35_memory_mb_variance, p.memory_mb_stddev AS prime35_memory_mb_stddev, b.avg_memory_mb AS blaze812_avg_memory_mb, b.memory_mb_variance AS blaze812_memory_mb_variance FROM Prime35InstanceMemoryStats AS p JOIN Blaze812InstanceMemoryStats AS b ON p.display_name = b.display_name ORDER BY p.memory_mb_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH ImageTypeMetadataOnHost AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstancesInAZOnHost AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT iaoh.vm_state, AVG(iaoh.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT iaoh.instance_uuid) AS instance_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT itmo.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_ImageType_Metadata_On_Host FROM InstancesInAZOnHost AS iaoh LEFT JOIN ImageTypeMetadataOnHost AS itmo ON iaoh.display_name = itmo.display_name WHERE iaoh.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY iaoh.vm_state HAVING AVG(iaoh.memory_mb) > 16000 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Flare3CompletedFlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME ~ 'flare'), CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.instance_display_name, f.migration_status, f.window_column AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS migration_id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS source_compute, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS dest_compute, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Flare3 flare* instances (completed migrations)' AS reason FROM Flare3CompletedFlareInstances AS f UNION ALL SELECT CAST(NULL AS CHAR(36)) AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS migration_status, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, c.migration_id, c.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, c.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, c.window_column AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Completed migrations on host blaze8-12' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost AS c) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason NULLS FIRST, instance_display_name NULLS FIRST, migration_id NULLS FIRST
